Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was stopped in the right lane of northbound traffic on a Conroe, Texas roadway when the vehicle directly
behind, operated by Driver 2, struck the rear of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 reported neck pain consistent with
whiplash and stated that the impact was sudden and forceful. A Passenger was also present in Driver 1's vehicle at
the time of the collision, and both the responding officer and independent witnesses confirmed that the Passenger
was seated isnide the vehicle when the impact occurred. Driver 2 acknowledged following too closely and did not
dispute how the collision happened. Several witnesses and photographs taken at the scene are consistent with the
account given by both drivers. The damage to the rear of Driver 1's vehicle lines up with the reported point and force
of impact. Officers found no indication of prior damage to either vehicle. Driver 1 is lsited as the named insured on the
policy covering the vehicle. Whether the reported neck injury was caused by this collision has not yet been
determined and will require further medical evaluation.
